limitations: Parameters and the quantities they are compared against come from the same labelling document, so this is internal consistency plus structural adequacy, not independent external validation.
A one-compartment model with first-order absorption is the simplest structure that fits the reported parameters. Agreement does not establish that the true disposition is one-compartment.
The label reports population means; no individual-level data are available, so between-subject variability is represented only by the standard deviations the label states.
Some parameters were derived rather than read: Absorption rate constant 2.539 /h solved from the reported Tmax of 1 h and ke = CL/V = 0.26 /h. The label does not report ka directly.
